body: 根据上传合成人物全身照片生成放在真实桌面上的全身动漫手办。保持站姿、微笑、短黑发、红圆眼镜、黄外套、白T恤、青绿裤和白鞋。手机随手拍三分之四视角，精细头发与衣料纹理、柔和渐变色，人物头到脚完整入镜，简洁圆底座，无文字。3:4。

instructions.en: Upload the reference images in the listed order. The example uses synthetic input images.
instructions.zh-Hans: 按列出的顺序上传参考图。本例使用合成输入素材。

en.title: Portrait to desk figurine
en.description: The full figure stands on a round desktop base; pose, bob haircut, red glasses and outfit colors remain recognizable.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. Upload the ordered synthetic reference images shown in the run before generating.

## Observed result

The full figure stands on a round desktop base; pose, bob haircut, red glasses and outfit colors remain recognizable.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 50. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
